pull_request.body:
## nODD geometry comparison — in progress

The [new review request](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/118#issuecomment-6744059438) is being addressed on the **maintained LAYOUT-001 tracker plus full Si–W barrel and both tiled endcaps**, with a freshly generated zero-field ODD control. This stage has no solenoid, field, HCAL, FCAL or muon system.

- **Native geometry PASS:** all ten system roots 0–9 match; 13,506,030 physical nodes and zero overlaps/extrusions at 1e-5 mm. [Compact native and initialized-transport proof](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/b77d31e365fa028ceb7de9e82886ebe6fcef3c90/docs/validation/issue117/previews/nodd-geometry-validation.json).
- **Actual initialized nODD controls PASS:** zero sampled field, 0.7-mm region cuts, zero silicon Birks constant and matched 5-mm charged-particle step limit in both ECAL regions.
- **Transport:** all 4,950 ODD control/reference/muon events completed and passed generation checks. The first 200 nODD shower events pass early truth/header/cell-identity checks. The complete nODD groups remain active; DDG4 assembly-path initialization and recurring Geant4 cut-couple scanning are slow. **No nODD digitizer/response comparison is claimed yet.**
- **Frozen comparison:** 4,550 nODD events versus 4,950 ODD events, fixed response settings, independent shared ODD calibration, paired raw/D/PN comparisons, both-endcap controls and original Key4hep checks on actual nODD hits. No geometry or response tuning.
- All **36 focused controls** pass. Separate source assessment verifies the physical-ID, empty-population, configuration/input and population-label guards. Actual results/figures still require execution and separate assessment.

[Current nODD report and recipe](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/b77d31e365fa028ceb7de9e82886ebe6fcef3c90/docs/validation/issue117/nodd-digitization-results.md) · [Frozen protocol](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/5afb019eac6e152608639d02223dda73098a197f/docs/validation/issue117/nodd-digitization-protocol.md)

New comparison plots will be embedded after actual execution. The completed ODD-only results below retain their original scope and immutable plots.

## Change

Refs #117. Resumes the reviewer-requested silicon digitizer validation after #123 supplied the original Key4hep runtime. The software-dependent deferral is superseded. The opt-in nODD ACTS adapter reuses pinned original MarlinReco energy methods through a separate GPL executable; the independent reference executes the original Key4hep **DigitiserSiliconMip Gaudi algorithm**.

This PR retains the DES-044 model survey for silicon, LAr, SiPM-on-tile and quartz-fibre calorimetry. It now includes same-hit original-framework checks and digitized single-particle plots. **DRAFT/PROTOTYPE design; no production integration, hardware-noise qualification or detector acceptance.** Issue #117 remains open for the remaining technology and physics requirements.

The benchmark below uses the unchanged **ODD comparison geometry**, with 48 sampling layers and its full configured field. The earlier nODD physical-tiling investigation is separate historical evidence, collapsed at the end.

## Original-framework agreement

- **Noise off:** 20 real ODD files, **4,600 events**, 2,714,303 input cells and **2,357,083 matched accepted cells**. Zero missing, extra, energy-mismatch or mismatched events. Original SimHits, contributions, MC endpoints and ordered EventHeaders are retained and checked.
- The comparator uses a float tolerance of 1e-5 + 5e-6 × max(|native|, |reference|) MIP. A conservative residual-bin bound also proves the stricter reference-only formula for every cell; worst normalized upper bound **0.250001 < 1**. Threshold selection must match exactly.
- **Stochastic:** pair-only and pair-plus-electronics modes on two 1,000-event conditional replay inputs (one real muon event and one real photon event). All eight event-CDF/mean checks and four energy-width interval gates pass. ROOT and CLHEP streams are independent; repeated source events do not constitute independent showers.
- Actual seed audits caught high-bit UID changes aliasing in ROOT's effective 32-bit seed. The replay varies run and event identifiers, verifies every effective seed, and preserves all other payload. The original algorithm remains unchanged. The report retains this finding, failed technical pilots and a separate synthetic zero/threshold/saturation/empty-event control.

![Original Key4hep versus native nODD digitizer comparison](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/6936cc5eb7fe9eeefa27d0e8f55f48fd5f3a0a3c/docs/validation/issue117/previews/digitization-reference.png)

[Compact reference data and exact execution provenance](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/6936cc5eb7fe9eeefa27d0e8f55f48fd5f3a0a3c/docs/validation/issue117/previews/digitization-reference.json)

## Digitized muon MIP, signal/noise and threshold response

New, held-out **250 muons per direction**, η=0 and 2, with detailed contribution/particle information. The **148.75-keV/MIP calibration stays frozen** from the earlier independent sample. Comparator settings are **0.13 MIP electronics RMS**, **0.6 MIP threshold** and **3.6 eV pair energy**; these are unsigned study parameters.

| η | PN Landau-component MPV [MIP] | Numerical convolved peak [MIP] | SNR | PN layer yield at 0.6 MIP |
| ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 0 | 0.9658 ± 0.0028 | 1.0205 ± 0.0033 | **7.422 ± 0.024** | **11965/12000 = 99.708%** |
| 2 | 0.9617 ± 0.0026 | 1.0152 ± 0.0032 | **7.391 ± 0.023** | **11964/12000 = 99.700%** |

SNR uses the fitted path-normalized Landau MPV divided by the measured **signed prethreshold pedestal RMS, 0.130119 ± 0.000206 MIP**. Both the Landau MPV and broadened numerical peak are shown, without forcing either to unity. All six fit populations completed 1,000/1,000 whole-event bootstrap fits; diagnostics and empirical modes remain in the data. Calibration/path/model systematics are separate.

The plot includes raw and digitized prethreshold spectra, **actual PN output above threshold**, signed pedestal, and the threshold scan on the same pulses. Primary-cell selection uses truth and approximate local chords, without a pulse cut. All **48 nominal layer opportunities per event** remain in the yield denominator; no missing primary layer was found here. Identified single/split crossing curves and conditional intervals are separate. Sparse split-category bootstrap errors are explicitly null when undefined; this is not full detector acceptance.

![Digitized muon MIP spectrum, SNR, signed pedestal and threshold response](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/6936cc5eb7fe9eeefa27d0e8f55f48fd5f3a0a3c/docs/validation/issue117/previews/digitized-mip.png)

## Single-electron and photon response

**3,600 test showers:** e−/γ at 5, 20 and 50 GeV/c, η=0/1/2, 200 events each. Raw, deterministic D and pair-plus-electronics PN stages use the **same events**, including zeros. Three independent 100-event 20-GeV/c electron references freeze one calibration factor per η, shared across energies, species and stages. Plotted denominators use persisted generated total energy.

Top: calibrated mean-response residuals. Bottom: **all-event sample SD/mean**, with 5,000 paired whole-event/reference bootstrap errors and shared calibration covariance retained. D disables both pair statistics and electronics; PN enables both. PN−D is their combined effect.

Digitization lowers mean silicon signal by **0.495–0.847%** across these populations. The larger forward distribution tails already exist in the raw events. These are response/spread measurements, **not a Gaussian core fit or reconstructed calorimeter energy resolution**; no per-energy calibration or geometry tuning is applied.

![Electron raw versus digitized response and distribution spread](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/6936cc5eb7fe9eeefa27d0e8f55f48fd5f3a0a3c/docs/validation/issue117/previews/digitized-electron.png)

![Photon raw versus digitized response and distribution spread](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/6936cc5eb7fe9eeefa27d0e8f55f48fd5f3a0a3c/docs/validation/issue117/previews/digitized-photon.png)

[Compact response, fit, histogram and covariance data](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/6936cc5eb7fe9eeefa27d0e8f55f48fd5f3a0a3c/docs/validation/issue117/previews/digitized-response.json) · [Executed results, limitations and reproduction commands](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/6936cc5eb7fe9eeefa27d0e8f55f48fd5f3a0a3c/docs/validation/issue117/digitization-results.md) · [Frozen protocol](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/6936cc5eb7fe9eeefa27d0e8f55f48fd5f3a0a3c/docs/validation/issue117/digitization-protocol.md)

## Validation and review

- Six native CTest suites passed, including silicon, ROOT I/O and comparison corruption controls.
- Six focused analysis/provenance controls passed, including zero-response handling, backend/log tamper rejection, Landau MPV convention and exact serial/parallel fit equality.
- Separate PhysVal agent review at 6936cc5e found no source/data/figure blocker: reconstructed the full paired shower bootstrap, all 500 muon selections/counts, central fits, pedestal, reference gates and immutable evidence; all four figures reproduce byte for byte. This is not human design approval.
- Session/project/interaction validation, token preview and whitespace checks passed during preparation. Hosted CI status is reported separately.
- Audited newly introduced Git objects: plots and compact binwise/fit/provenance evidence only. Full ROOT events, raw diagnostics, replay payloads, pedestal draws and detailed logs stay local and ignored.

<details>
<summary>Earlier endcap geometry investigation and exploratory comparisons — retained historical evidence</summary>

The physical nODD tiling study and earlier segmentation displays remain available with their original immutable provenance. They do not establish digitizer agreement and are not used as the current MIP/shower validation. No endcap geometry is changed by this follow-up; the proposed separate geometry issue/PR disposition remains with maintainers.

**nODD tiling/control raw-Geant4 scan:** 7,600 response plus 100 reference events in the complete positive 48-layer/16-sector endcap. Selected 20-GeV centre/gap silicon-signal reductions were 9.4%/65.4% against a control that fills gaps and activates guards; these are local raw effects, not area-averaged detector loss.

![Historical nODD tiling/control raw response](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/97ba1015c1c3616d854e45be638d93d2d358160b/docs/validation/issue117/previews/nodd-tiling-response.png)

![Historical raw tiled/control spectra](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/97ba1015c1c3616d854e45be638d93d2d358160b/docs/validation/issue117/previews/nodd-tiling-spectra.png)

![Historical raw longitudinal profiles](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/97ba1015c1c3616d854e45be638d93d2d358160b/docs/validation/issue117/previews/nodd-tiling-longitudinal.png)

[Full geometry-response report and recipe](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/97ba1015c1c3616d854e45be638d93d2d358160b/docs/validation/issue117/tiling-response.md)

**Tiled nODD segmentation restored by #115:** 16 wedge carriers ×112 tiles per layer, 76 square plus 36 custom per wedge; square blanks 90 mm, active 88 mm, nominal pads 5.5 mm. The full-face panel is a geometry guide. The raw display fixture used 512 muons, three layers of one wedge, with no efficiency claim.

![Historical tiled nODD layout and sensitive-hit segmentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/026efea28b4a8c58fbc0e1426dfa5d61d7118dea/docs/validation/issue117/previews/nodd-tiled-endcap-xy.png)

**Earlier upstream ODD previews:** retained for provenance; the current full-reference and digitized plots above supersede their validation status.

![Earlier ODD electron-response preview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/01da03456fcfc107992f3b955d0ffaf0449c5c82/docs/validation/issue117/previews/response.png)

![Earlier ODD muon MIP preview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/01da03456fcfc107992f3b955d0ffaf0449c5c82/docs/validation/issue117/previews/mip.png)

The following upstream ODD projection shows continuous silicon wedges with 5.1-mm virtual cells, rather than nODD's physical tile layout.

issues.body:
## Goal
Reuse existing, validated calorimeter digitization models rather than writing our
own. Survey candidates for every calorimeter technology on `main`, then implement
and validate one end to end in the `CalorimeterDigitizationAlgorithm` skeleton.

Technologies: Si-W ECAL (DES-031), ALLEGRO-style LAr ECAL (DES-032/033),
steel/scintillator SiPM-on-tile HCAL (DES-036–038), W/quartz-fibre FCAL (DES-039).

## Starting leads (verify paths and versions)
- ATLAS Athena: `LArDigitization`, `LArROD` (OFC), `CaloTools` noise, `TileSimAlgs`
- CMS CMSSW: `HGCalSimProducers` (HGCDigitizer), HGCAL Si/scintillator noise maps,
  `HcalSimAlgos` (SiPM, HF), `SimG4CMS/Calo` (HF fibres)
- FCC-ee/Key4hep: `k4RecCalorimeter` (ALLEGRO cells, noise, calibration), HEP-FCC `dual-readout`
- ILD/CLIC: MarlinReco `DDCaloDigi`, `RealisticCaloDigiSilicon` / `RealisticCaloDigiScinPpd`
- EIC: EICrecon `CalorimeterHitDigi` (EDM4hep-native generic baseline)

ALLEGRO and ILD target low-pileup e+e−; note what each model needs for 14 TeV, μ=200
(pulse shape and out-of-time pileup for LAr, radiation-dependent noise for Si/SiPM).

## Scope
1. Survey: per technology, candidate model(s), effects covered (sampling fraction,
   Birks/photostatistics, SiPM saturation, noise, pulse shape, out-of-time pileup,
   ADC/ToA, thresholds), framework coupling and reuse effort.
2. Implement the recommended model for the **Si-W ECAL first**, using ODD's ECAL
   (same technology family) so it runs on existing ODD `ddsim` samples.
3. Validate:
   - **Unit:** noise-only events reproduce configured noise RMS and threshold rates;
     single muons give the expected MIP peak.
   - **Reference comparison:** same `ddsim` hits through the original implementation
     (e.g. Key4hep `DDCaloDigi` / `k4RecCalorimeter`) and ours agree.
   - **Physics:** single e/γ at several energies and η give sampling fraction,
     linearity and resolution consistent in scale with published Si-W results.

The EDM4hep input converter currently needs a cellID → cell-centre lookup; `ddsim`
hits already carry the cell position, so an option to use it is in scope.

The Si-W implementation is a **PROTOTYPE** until the DES is signed off.

## Done when
- [ ] DES draft recommending one model per technology, with references and open questions
- [ ] Si-W ECAL digitization implemented with unit and reference-comparison tests passing
- [ ] Single-particle response plots with recipe (binwise outputs only, per ADR-003)
- [ ] Follow-up issues listed for the remaining technologies

## nODD geometry comparison — in progress

The [new review request](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/118#issuecomment-6744059438) is being addressed on the **maintained LAYOUT-001 tracker plus full Si–W barrel and both tiled endcaps**, with a freshly generated zero-field ODD control. This stage has no solenoid, field, HCAL, FCAL or muon system.

- **Native geometry PASS:** all ten system roots 0–9 match; 13,506,030 physical nodes and zero overlaps/extrusions at 1e-5 mm. [Compact native and initialized-transport proof](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/b77d31e365fa028ceb7de9e82886ebe6fcef3c90/docs/validation/issue117/previews/nodd-geometry-validation.json).
- **Actual initialized nODD controls PASS:** zero sampled field, 0.7-mm region cuts, zero silicon Birks constant and matched 5-mm charged-particle step limit in both ECAL regions.
- **Transport:** all 4,950 ODD control/reference/muon events completed and passed generation checks. The first 200 nODD shower events pass early truth/header/cell-identity checks. The complete nODD groups remain active; DDG4 assembly-path initialization and recurring Geant4 cut-couple scanning are slow. **No nODD digitizer/response comparison is claimed yet.**
- **Frozen comparison:** 4,550 nODD events versus 4,950 ODD events, fixed response settings, independent shared ODD calibration, paired raw/D/PN comparisons, both-endcap controls and original Key4hep checks on actual nODD hits. No geometry or response tuning.
- All **36 focused controls** pass. Separate source assessment verifies the physical-ID, empty-population, configuration/input and population-label guards. Actual results/figures still require execution and separate assessment.

[Current nODD report and recipe](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/b77d31e365fa028ceb7de9e82886ebe6fcef3c90/docs/validation/issue117/nodd-digitization-results.md) · [Frozen protocol](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/5afb019eac6e152608639d02223dda73098a197f/docs/validation/issue117/nodd-digitization-protocol.md)

New comparison plots will be embedded after actual execution. The completed ODD-only results below retain their original scope and immutable plots.

## Change

Refs #117. Resumes the reviewer-requested silicon digitizer validation after #123 supplied the original Key4hep runtime. The software-dependent deferral is superseded. The opt-in nODD ACTS adapter reuses pinned original MarlinReco energy methods through a separate GPL executable; the independent reference executes the original Key4hep **DigitiserSiliconMip Gaudi algorithm**.

This PR retains the DES-044 model survey for silicon, LAr, SiPM-on-tile and quartz-fibre calorimetry. It now includes same-hit original-framework checks and digitized single-particle plots. **DRAFT/PROTOTYPE design; no production integration, hardware-noise qualification or detector acceptance.** Issue #117 remains open for the remaining technology and physics requirements.

The benchmark below uses the unchanged **ODD comparison geometry**, with 48 sampling layers and its full configured field. The earlier nODD physical-tiling investigation is separate historical evidence, collapsed at the end.

## Original-framework agreement

- **Noise off:** 20 real ODD files, **4,600 events**, 2,714,303 input cells and **2,357,083 matched accepted cells**. Zero missing, extra, energy-mismatch or mismatched events. Original SimHits, contributions, MC endpoints and ordered EventHeaders are retained and checked.
- The comparator uses a float tolerance of 1e-5 + 5e-6 × max(|native|, |reference|) MIP. A conservative residual-bin bound also proves the stricter reference-only formula for every cell; worst normalized upper bound **0.250001 < 1**. Threshold selection must match exactly.
- **Stochastic:** pair-only and pair-plus-electronics modes on two 1,000-event conditional replay inputs (one real muon event and one real photon event). All eight event-CDF/mean checks and four energy-width interval gates pass. ROOT and CLHEP streams are independent; repeated source events do not constitute independent showers.
- Actual seed audits caught high-bit UID changes aliasing in ROOT's effective 32-bit seed. The replay varies run and event identifiers, verifies every effective seed, and preserves all other payload. The original algorithm remains unchanged. The report retains this finding, failed technical pilots and a separate synthetic zero/threshold/saturation/empty-event control.

![Original Key4hep versus native nODD digitizer comparison](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/6936cc5eb7fe9eeefa27d0e8f55f48fd5f3a0a3c/docs/validation/issue117/previews/digitization-reference.png)

[Compact reference data and exact execution provenance](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/6936cc5eb7fe9eeefa27d0e8f55f48fd5f3a0a3c/docs/validation/issue117/previews/digitization-reference.json)

## Digitized muon MIP, signal/noise and threshold response

New, held-out **250 muons per direction**, η=0 and 2, with detailed contribution/particle information. The **148.75-keV/MIP calibration stays frozen** from the earlier independent sample. Comparator settings are **0.13 MIP electronics RMS**, **0.6 MIP threshold** and **3.6 eV pair energy**; these are unsigned study parameters.

| η | PN Landau-component MPV [MIP] | Numerical convolved peak [MIP] | SNR | PN layer yield at 0.6 MIP |
| ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 0 | 0.9658 ± 0.0028 | 1.0205 ± 0.0033 | **7.422 ± 0.024** | **11965/12000 = 99.708%** |
| 2 | 0.9617 ± 0.0026 | 1.0152 ± 0.0032 | **7.391 ± 0.023** | **11964/12000 = 99.700%** |

SNR uses the fitted path-normalized Landau MPV divided by the measured **signed prethreshold pedestal RMS, 0.130119 ± 0.000206 MIP**. Both the Landau MPV and broadened numerical peak are shown, without forcing either to unity. All six fit populations completed 1,000/1,000 whole-event bootstrap fits; diagnostics and empirical modes remain in the data. Calibration/path/model systematics are separate.

The plot includes raw and digitized prethreshold spectra, **actual PN output above threshold**, signed pedestal, and the threshold scan on the same pulses. Primary-cell selection uses truth and approximate local chords, without a pulse cut. All **48 nominal layer opportunities per event** remain in the yield denominator; no missing primary layer was found here. Identified single/split crossing curves and conditional intervals are separate. Sparse split-category bootstrap errors are explicitly null when undefined; this is not full detector acceptance.

![Digitized muon MIP spectrum, SNR, signed pedestal and threshold response](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/6936cc5eb7fe9eeefa27d0e8f55f48fd5f3a0a3c/docs/validation/issue117/previews/digitized-mip.png)

## Single-electron and photon response

**3,600 test showers:** e−/γ at 5, 20 and 50 GeV/c, η=0/1/2, 200 events each. Raw, deterministic D and pair-plus-electronics PN stages use the **same events**, including zeros. Three independent 100-event 20-GeV/c electron references freeze one calibration factor per η, shared across energies, species and stages. Plotted denominators use persisted generated total energy.

Top: calibrated mean-response residuals. Bottom: **all-event sample SD/mean**, with 5,000 paired whole-event/reference bootstrap errors and shared calibration covariance retained. D disables both pair statistics and electronics; PN enables both. PN−D is their combined effect.

Digitization lowers mean silicon signal by **0.495–0.847%** across these populations. The larger forward distribution tails already exist in the raw events. These are response/spread measurements, **not a Gaussian core fit or reconstructed calorimeter energy resolution**; no per-energy calibration or geometry tuning is applied.

![Electron raw versus digitized response and distribution spread](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/6936cc5eb7fe9eeefa27d0e8f55f48fd5f3a0a3c/docs/validation/issue117/previews/digitized-electron.png)

![Photon raw versus digitized response and distribution spread](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/6936cc5eb7fe9eeefa27d0e8f55f48fd5f3a0a3c/docs/validation/issue117/previews/digitized-photon.png)

[Compact response, fit, histogram and covariance data](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/6936cc5eb7fe9eeefa27d0e8f55f48fd5f3a0a3c/docs/validation/issue117/previews/digitized-response.json) · [Executed results, limitations and reproduction commands](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/6936cc5eb7fe9eeefa27d0e8f55f48fd5f3a0a3c/docs/validation/issue117/digitization-results.md) · [Frozen protocol](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/6936cc5eb7fe9eeefa27d0e8f55f48fd5f3a0a3c/docs/validation/issue117/digitization-protocol.md)

## Validation and review

- Six native CTest suites passed, including silicon, ROOT I/O and comparison corruption controls.
- Six focused analysis/provenance controls passed, including zero-response handling, backend/log tamper rejection, Landau MPV convention and exact serial/parallel fit equality.
- Separate PhysVal agent review at 6936cc5e found no source/data/figure blocker: reconstructed the full paired shower bootstrap, all 500 muon selections/counts, central fits, pedestal, reference gates and immutable evidence; all four figures reproduce byte for byte. This is not human design approval.
- Session/project/interaction validation, token preview and whitespace checks passed during preparation. Hosted CI status is reported separately.
- Audited newly introduced Git objects: plots and compact binwise/fit/provenance evidence only. Full ROOT events, raw diagnostics, replay payloads, pedestal draws and detailed logs stay local and ignored.
